description.value: YOTEA is a modern fruit-tea brand founded in Shenzhen in 2014, credited as the originator of the 'Square Cup Fruit Tea,' now operating its first British Columbia location inside Richmond's Continental Shopping Centre. The menu features signature fruit teas with fresh-cut fruit, lemon teas made with air-flown fragrant lemons from Guangdong, fresh fruit slushes, and cold-pressed juices served in the brand's distinctive hedgehog-branded bottles. Cycling through Richmond's south end, a rider could stop here for a cold, fruit-forward drink rather than a full meal.
